cc:Work.dc:description: Cells show means; exact denominators are in the metric explorer and JSON. Joint outcomes attributed to both models are dependent. Cooperation/competition are the first/second action labels: lockdown and quarantine are legitimate alternatives. N/A means not applicable or missing, not zero. Utility scales vary across games.
